versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the fire detection system is designed to preclude false warnings. Standard: Redundancy is provided in the fire detection system to avoid false warnings. All failures of the fire detection system are flagged and reported to maintenance. Method of Compliance: Analysis demonstrates avoidance of false warnings. Component tests verify performance of the failure indication systems. Component tests verify the alarm set points to avoid false alarm. Ground and flight tests verify there are no false alarms at all ground and flight conditions.
